newsitem.title: CHINA: Timing of HK railway link hinges on airport - MTRC.
newsitem.headline: Timing of HK railway link hinges on airport - MTRC.

text.p: Hong Kong's Mass Transit Railway Corp (MTRC) said on Wednesday it would have to be sure of the opening date of the new Chek Lap Kok airport before it committed to accelerating work on the airport railway link.
"We have always said June (1998) is our opening date, and we are still confident that we will meet that particular date," MTRC chairman Jack So told reporters.
"We have also said that we realise the importance of opening the airport railway together with the commencement of the new airport (in April)," So said.
"But that would require a major decision of investment, of speeding up the works, and therefore we have to be really sure of the opening date of the airport before we take that particular decision."
His comments follow earlier reports that some airport facilities may not be completed by the time airport opens.
The US$9 billion Chek Lap Kok airport is expected to handle 87 million passengers and nine million tonnes of cargo when the second of its two runways opens later in 1998.
In April, the MTRC said it was looking at ways of advancing the railway opening to coincide with that of Chek Lap Kok.
